0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers, who are 2-0 and 1-0 on the road, visit the 3-0 Los Angeles Lakers in Portland's third game of the season, with Portland currently 2nd in the Northwest and 4th in the West and the Lakers 1st in the Pacific and the West. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Portland won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026. Shaedon Sharpe is out for Portland with a knee injury following surgery, while Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. For the Lakers, Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain) are both out.
